reviewer: Claude (AI assistant), at the request of the project owner. A review of FICTIONAL test data, not a kitchen audit.

criteria.R1: every ingredient id is known to the taxonomy and itemized (no blend or mix with hidden contents)
criteria.R2: the Arabic ingredient names correspond one-to-one to the ingredient ids
criteria.R3: the recorded allergens are exactly the allergens implied by the ingredients (none missing, none extra)
criteria.R4: recorded allergen ids are known and not duplicated
criteria.R5: the description does not mention a food, or an allergen, that the record does not declare
criteria.R6: the dish was read against the description by the reviewer and judged coherent (recorded in the review file)

dish_001.reviewer_notes: Description (rice, chicken, spices, red sauce) matches the ingredients; the red sauce is the listed tomato. No major allergen is implied by any ingredient.

dish_002.reviewer_notes: Lamb, rice and itemized spices; ghee is the only allergen source (milk), which is recorded.

dish_003.reviewer_notes: Chicken, rice, garlic, coriander and chili match the description; nothing implies an allergen.
